name: TEDxKIET
description: TEDxKIET is a student-led initiative licensed by TED, dedicated to bringing eminent personalities and thoughtful leaders from diverse fields to share their ideas worth spreading. The club’s mission is to inspire, ignite conversations, and empower the KIET community through impactful talks and experiences.

events.title: TEDxKIET 2026
events.desc: A flagship TEDx event hosted at KIET on 10 April 2026 with over 200 student participants. Distinguished speakers from fields such as authorship, journalism, entrepreneurship, performing arts, cybersecurity, and leadership shared ideas and experiences, fostering innovation, critical thinking, and personal growth among attendees.
